custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new part number that no Part Library entry has and no inventory part uses.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with an approved line.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425616 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425616 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
